problem: 全高左栏把无功能的空白误表现为组件；时间卡重复标题、说明、图标与时间；配置编辑器无法区分普通公共配置、可运行任务配置和错误配置。
scope: 只改变导航容器外观、设置页时间信息层级、受限配置导入和诊断投影；保留六个导航目的地、键盘合同、主题、即时校时、插件由配置顶层声明和任务执行合同。
baseline: 112px 全高侧栏产生约 600px 无归属空白；时间区域有图标、标题、说明、粗体时间和输入五层；配置 GET 只返回 plugin_loaded，外部错误文件可能直接造成解析异常。
benchmarks: Material navigation rail for three to seven top-level destinations
GitHub Primer NavList short labels and current item semantics
W3C WCAG 2.2 target size and visible focus
WAI-ARIA timer with implicit aria-live off
python-library-configlib raw include and composition loader
advantages: 六个目的地已有短中文标签、图标和方向键行为
服务器时间已有单次取样加单调增量，不需要新增轮询
配置仓库已有路径隔离、版本、原子写和插件注册表
disadvantages: 导航视觉容器与页面分栏轨道绑定
每秒时间更新没有 timer 语义
任务目录用路径规则强制 plugin，无法容纳公共导入片段
limitations: 导航仍固定左上，页面内容仍为独立滚动区域
公共片段只诊断已出现的公共字段，不声称可独立运行
第三方插件若未声明 config_model，只能完成公共字段和插件存在性诊断
配置导入必须限制在 config 根目录
defects: 左栏背景和边框贯穿整个视口
普通配置和任务配置没有分类
插件专属字段没有保存前诊断
bottlenecks: CSS inset 同时设置 top 和 bottom
SettingsPage 单个卡片承担说明与操作两种所有权
parse_config 只解析字符串，无法安全解析相对 include

hypotheses: 让 aside 按内容收缩而让 grid 轨道继续占位可同时消除空带并避免内容横跳
日期与时分秒合并为 timer、输入自身带唯一标签可删除图标和说明
公共字段命中分类加插件 config_model 能在不误报普通文件的前提下给出分层诊断
先限制 include 图再调用 configlib 可复用成熟加载器且不扩大读取边界

compact navigation, timer and diagnostic UI

hard_gates: visible navigation container is content-height and under 300px at 1440x900
all six navigation targets remain at least 40px high with visible current and focus states
narrow viewport has no horizontal overflow
time section has one non-announcing live timer and one labelled datetime-local calibration control
zero-common-field object is generic and any-common-field object is diagnosed as a fragment
plugin remains sourced only from the configuration top level
loaded plugin schema diagnoses required and unknown plugin fields
includes outside config are rejected before loading
axe serious and critical violations remain zero
failure_fixtures: plain metadata object is classified as a task
success_fixtures: six-item compact navigation at wide and narrow viewport
shared common fragment diagnoses valid but not runnable
command config diagnoses valid and runnable
task includes a shared file inside config
rollback: Restore round 6 navigation/settings markup and direct parsers; leave user files and task history untouched.

iteration_budget.review_trigger: one hard gate failure or no geometry reduction

stop_conditions: success, failure and fault fixtures classify correctly
navigation and time metrics meet thresholds
full Python, Edge, quality and Ubuntu gates pass

promotion_decision.reason: content-height primary navigation and non-announcing live clock rules generalize to compact operator consoles

writeback: Project screenshots, field names and configlib version remain in project evidence; reusable navigation ownership, timer semantics and classification rules update the local operator console reference.
